page_text_original: OT-bjælken (omvendt T-bjælke) bruges bla. til vores betonbroer. ... produceres og kontrolleres i henhold til DS/EN 15050 ... Broelementer produceres som standard i styrkeklasse 45/55
geometry_notes: Right half (sharp): (590, 0) -> (590, 140) -> (280, 170) -> (150, 255) -> (150, H) -> (0, H). The flange top rises 30 mm from the tip to the haunch start 130 mm from the 300 mm web; the haunch rises 85 mm.
The small bottom-corner rounding visible on the 317 px diagram is undimensioned and omitted.
CONVENTION: the producer gives a continuous depth range 500-1400 mm; profiles are enumerated at 100 mm steps (OT 118/500 ... OT 118/1400). The step is not a published catalogue increment.
No section properties published for OT (the IB/RB load tables are building beams and are not used).
